Type: square tabletop planter with stand
Use: holding a small plant on a table, shelf or desk; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: modern, minimalist, glam
Materials: matte ceramic pot, copper-finished metal wire stand
Colors: light grey, rose copper
Shape: tapered square pot lifted in an open cubic wire frame, compact, light and open
Feel: fresh, neat, modern
Goes with: white or blush walls, marble, succulents; modern or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: AmazonBasics Tabletop Planter, Square - Grey/Copper
product.description: Indoor desk planter for home or office, ideal for growing and displaying small indoor plants such as air plants or succulents like aloe vera or a pincushion cactus Enhances any home or office with on-trend style and beautiful eye-catching modern design aesthetics Made of stoneware ceramic and durable steel for beauty and strength; add gravel or pebbles to the bottom of the planter for drainage purposes Tabletop-style pot with square-shaped metal support; grey and copper color Backed by an AmazonBasics 1-year limited warranty
